_comment: Enable/disable sources. exclude_agencies removes adverts from recruitment agencies (list in config/agencies.json); career_sites reads employers' own careers pages (config/employers.json); channel says how candidates apply: career_site, official (NHS/universities/schools/government boards) or aggregator. Keyed sources read credentials from environment variables (GitHub Actions secrets). RSS feeds: add any RSS/Atom job feed; 'country' is ISO 3166 alpha-2.

jobtech_sweden._note: Platsbanken (Swedish Public Employment Service) open API: no key needed. Adverts include the employer's named contacts.

jobs_ac_uk._note: jobs.ac.uk search (UK and overseas universities). Its RSS feeds were withdrawn; adverts are read from their schema.org JobPosting data.

the_unijobs._note: Times Higher Education unijobs RSS (universities worldwide); each listing page is read for the full advert.

rss._note: Add any RSS/Atom job feed here, e.g. a council or university vacancy feed. The jobs.ac.uk and EURAXESS RSS addresses used before were withdrawn (404) and are now read by their own connectors.
